Market today: Bonds are calming down a bit, which is good for stocks, especially the tech names we like. The big driver is still the bond market's mood.

Your holdings: SOXL is still a big loser (-52.53%) and needs attention. SMH (-11.81%) and QQQI (-3.79%) are also flagged for trim. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep an eye on bond yields and how they react to Treasury buybacks. Also, watch how the market digests the Moderna news.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged positions and watching the bond market's reaction.
plays: Trim SMH if it breaks below 540.
Trim QQQI if it breaks below 52.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
